## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The decision-card JSON schema carries a schema version and validates every...

The system SHALL ensure that the decision-card JSON schema carries a schema version and validates every card emitted in tests; a card missing a breadcrumb, since-last-seen summary, numbered options, recommendation, default, or deadline is rejected.

#### Scenario: The decision-card JSON schema carries a schema version and validates every...

WHEN `define-the-decision-card-schema-and-markdown-renderer` is implemented
THEN The decision-card JSON schema carries a schema version and validates every card emitted in tests; a card missing a breadcrumb, since-last-seen summary, numbered options, recommendation, default, or deadline is rejected.

### Requirement: Rendering the same card twice yields byte-identical markdown, and the...

The system SHALL ensure that rendering the same card twice yields byte-identical markdown, and the rendered canonical merge and escalate-resume cards each fit within 1,200 characters.

#### Scenario: Rendering the same card twice yields byte-identical markdown, and the...

WHEN `define-the-decision-card-schema-and-markdown-renderer` is implemented
THEN Rendering the same card twice yields byte-identical markdown, and the rendered canonical merge and escalate-resume cards each fit within 1,200 characters.

### Requirement: The token parser maps option tokens (2, 1a) to the matching option and...

The system SHALL ensure that the token parser maps option tokens (2, 1a) to the matching option and returns an explicit no-match for tokens that name no option, covered by unit tests.

#### Scenario: The token parser maps option tokens (2, 1a) to the matching option and...

WHEN `define-the-decision-card-schema-and-markdown-renderer` is implemented
THEN The token parser maps option tokens (2, 1a) to the matching option and returns an explicit no-match for tokens that name no option, covered by unit tests.

### Requirement: A rendered card contains no repository-relative paths that require opening...

The system SHALL ensure that a rendered card contains no repository-relative paths that require opening the repo to understand the decision (self-contained constraint), checked by a fixture test.

#### Scenario: A rendered card contains no repository-relative paths that require opening...

WHEN `define-the-decision-card-schema-and-markdown-renderer` is implemented
THEN A rendered card contains no repository-relative paths that require opening the repo to understand the decision (self-contained constraint), checked by a fixture test.
